<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Implements a protocol for serializing and deserializing data.

Description: This class is used to define a protocol for data serialization and deserialization. It is instantiated by services that need to handle data in a standardized format. The `loads` method deserializes a payload into any Python object, while the `dumps` method serializes any Python object into a standardized format.

Attributes:
    None
</DOCSTRING>
